meta.title: Optimize group by compilation
meta.body_summary: Optimize VM compiler for group queries by storing group index separately, regenerating IR golden files; no explicit performance measurement.

perf_labels.notes: Compiler change with golden IR test updates; merged instantly by author without review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1746 changed lines, the PR is numerically medium-sized, but the core compiler change in vm.go is only 40 lines; the rest are automatically regenerated IR golden files. This fits a small-step compiler optimization that merged instantly without review, consistent with a maintainer self-approving a low-risk change.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or comments recorded; PR was merged without any reviewer interaction.
review_details.performance_claim: Optimize group-by query compilation (no numeric speedup claimed).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Compiler-level optimization in a Go VM can be generated by the agent and verified by existing golden tests; the absence of review suggests maintainer confidence in the agent's output for this kind of change.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Golden IR files provide a regression test of compiler output, but no performance benchmark or reproducible measurement is included.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, modified the VM compiler's group-by compilation to store the group index separately, leading to a different intermediate representation (IR). All affected IR golden files under tests/vm/valid/ were regenerated to reflect the new output.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: These files capture the expected IR output after the compiler change; they were automatically updated by the test suite.
change_trajectory: Single commit modifying VM compiler and regenerating IR golden files.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by tamnd with a single commit; merged immediately by the same user without any review process.
